Messages.Author: Pat
Messages.Body:
Bright Idea #1:

So if you play Conscripted Statue at VIC and then play Change of Target to
untap Tupdog and cancel the action, does the Statue fight the blocker? Or
does the Statue burn with no combat?

The only reason I can think of to do this is if Tupdog's rush is blocked,
and you would prefer to have him bleed for 1, or you have a rush action in
hand that he can use to try again. But since the statue cycles nicely before
combat at vic, it should never jam your hand.

Bright Idea #2:

The Anti-Turbo Tupdog Deck:

You might actually want to do this if you've tooled Tupdog up a little bit
with a For skill card... after Tupdog rushes, and assuming he doesn't die in
the resulting combat, your token !Tremere calls Banishment. Tupdog is
uncontrolled at the end of your minion phase, so he doesn't burn. He comes
out for 1 pool, or none if he had a blood on him, then is all refreshed and
ready to fight again, this time as a mighty 2-cap with POT-VIS-for!

This vampire alone is going to make the pre-release a lot of fun, I think.
:)

- Pat

P.S. So do we think he's going to be a Common, to ease the task of
constructing the 30-Tupdog crypt?
